description: Check any AI agent before you install or call it. Pass just its `url` (site, A2A agent card, MCP server card / server.json or OpenAPI link): GAIP fetches the card, validates it against the A2A, MCP or OpenAPI spec, tests that its endpoint answers and returns READY / FIXES_NEEDED / NO_AGENT_CARD / UNREACHABLE. Or pass the card itself as `metadata`. Every finding has a severity, JSON path, plain-English fix and spec link, plus a 0-100 score and a JSON Patch with placeholders; the receipt verifies with verify_gaip_receipt. Set mode=VERIFY_BEFORE_CALL with `target` to get task-specific evidence about a counterparty instead. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

expected_endpoint.description: Optional: the endpoint you expect; a different primary endpoint is reported as ENDPOINT_DRIFT.

protocol.description: Counterparty protocol. Inferred from metadata when omitted, otherwise MCP.

source_url.description: Optional: where `metadata` was published, used only to resolve relative endpoints. Never fetched.

url.description: Public https link to an agent, its A2A agent card, MCP server description or OpenAPI document. GAIP fetches, validates and reach-tests it. Use instead of metadata.

name: check_agent_conformance
title: Check an agent interface
